versions.subject: Detect RipZip attack

selection1: # %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\target.lnk.{0AFACED1-E828-11D1-9187-B532F1E9575D}\target.lnk
    - TargetFileName|contains: '\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup'

    - OriginalFileName: 'explorer.exe'
condition: all of selection*
